Crisp house music with a view
Nov 2023 • Friends
I had a really good time at Cocoon Rooftop. This part of district 1 is quickly developing but still proposes an interesting mix of traditional and new modern places. Cocoon is one of the latest. The rooftop on level 8 is easily accessible by the elevator and offers a beautiful view of district 1. I would say it's a medium size bar and while providing space and fresh air to its customers, it still has intimate corners. I really enjoyed the setting, with the bar in the middle and different people sitting or standing around. Customers were of mix of party goers and casuals drinkers, both Vietnamese and foreigner. Music was surprisingly really crisp for an outdoor space, while the speakers delivered just enough bases for the dancers. Enjoy!
